The plate looks like a round compostable plate, about 20 cm across in the image, spanning roughly 255 px. The food cluster is about 160 px wide, so roughly 12 cm, and it is a small pile of cooked chicken pieces with some sauce or skin.

The pile is about 12 cm by 9 cm and perhaps 2 cm thick. That gives roughly 100 to 150 cm³ once gaps between pieces are accounted for. At about 1 g/cm³ this is around 70 g of food.

Cooked chicken with skin is about 2 kcal/g, so 70 g comes to roughly 140 kcal. Allowing for sauce, I'd put it at about 150 kcal.
